newsitem.title: USA: Interactive Flight clarifies Qantas outlook.
newsitem.headline: Interactive Flight clarifies Qantas outlook.

text.p: Interactive Flight Technologies Inc said Tuesday that Qantas Airways expects to begin installing in-flight gaming systems on its aircraft by April 1998.
Interactive Flight said it was issuing the statement in response to a May 22 Reuters story, datelined Sydney, that said Qantas did not expect to decide on a system until April 1998.
Interactive Flight said it confirmed with Qantas that the date referred to was a planned installation date, not a target date for reaching a decision on a system.

Interactive Flight has been invited by Qantas to bid on a project to install gaming systems on aircraft used in international flights. The airline is also seeking clearance from the Australian government to offer in-flight gambling.
